retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant West Coast urban collage featuring a central blue lowrider, palm tree silhouettes, and a warm sunset skyline with bold block typography.
excludeWhen: rural or natural landscapes without urban elements

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered digital composition centered on the rear view of a classic blue lowrider, flanked by two other lowriders in motion, set against a backdrop of a city skyline, palm trees, and a glowing orange sunset. A central rectangular frame contains monochromatic portraits and heavy block lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Central blue car acts as the primary foreground anchor
Symmetrical flanking by red and yellow cars creates dynamic movement
Warm sunset glow provides a high-contrast background for dark silhouettes
Central framed text block serves as the primary focal point
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective of a classic American car rear
Silhouetted palm trees framing the composition

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large blue lowrider occupies the lower center; a rectangular screen-like frame sits directly above it in the middle ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The rear bumper and taillights of the blue car.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright blue car, move up to the central text frame, then outward to the palm trees and skyline.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense and filled with urban and automotive elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm oranges and yellows from the sunset sky.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blues and blacks in the car body and silhouettes.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red from the taillights and the flanking car.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the sky and car paint; high contrast between the bright sun and dark silhouettes.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold condensed display paired with a script-style logo and a standard sans-serif for metadata.
graphicDevices: Black and white photo filter for inset portraits

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and authoritative feel of the central text.
Provides the necessary verticality and blocky structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a digital collage of a blue lowrider rear view in the foreground, a red car on the left, a yellow car on the right, palm trees, and a sunset city skyline. Leave a central rectangular area for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, white, condensed sans-serif text in a stacked format inside the central frame. Add a parental advisory logo in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the text condensed and uppercase?
Are palm trees framing the sides?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the background
Verify the sunset gradient is smooth
Confirm the parental advisory logo is correctly placed
recipe.reuseFormula: Central subject + flanking motion + framed typography + sunset urban backdrop
